name: scene_batch_7
title: Card scenes, batch 7
intro: Keep or reject each scene, in the C and E mix. Each tile is the bare scene over two real cards, a program or event and a building, composed at 300 dpi with the full bleed showing: the program window is the whole scene, the building window its center. Scenes are a pool: the card a scene was written for is a suggestion. The second card only shows the other window. For true size, print art-originals/scenes/b7/cards.pdf at 100%. Use the notes for what to change.

rows.label: 1. Cyber: A big corkboard of bounty notices in a bright open co-working loft, each notice pinned with a painted beetle sketch and a cash envelope, two hackers with laptops pulling a notice down to claim it.
rows.note: Written for Bug Bounty Board. Shown on Adaptive Malware and Bug Bounty Board. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 2. Diplomacy: A sunlit briefing room where a handful of envoys in travel coats sit at a long table with open folders and a large plain world map on the wall, a senior diplomat pointing at it, suitcases waiting by the door.
rows.note: Written for Envoy Briefings. Shown on Envoy Briefings and Civic Watch. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 3. Industry: Seen from a hill, small workshops and parts plants dotted across green farmland, delivery trucks on every road converging on one big modern assembly plant at the center.
rows.note: Written for Supplier Network. Shown on Antitrust Action and Supplier Network. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 4. Industry: A modern car assembly line being refitted in a hurry, workers swapping robot arms and wheeling in new heavy power generators and transformer units, half the line already turning out olive-drab utility vehicles.
rows.note: Written for Wartime Retooling. Shown on Wartime Retooling and Capital Projects Office. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 5. Power: A modern university campus of glass buildings on a green lawn around a big doughnut-shaped fusion reactor hall with its roof cut away, scientists crossing the lawn, the reactor's ring glowing softly inside.
rows.note: Written for Fusion Research Campus. Shown on Aegis Grid Lockdown and Fusion Research Campus. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 6. Science: A tall gleaming research rocket on a launch pad at the edge of a university research park, a pale moon in the daytime sky above it, scientists in shirtsleeves wheeling crates of glowing sky-blue research cubes to its base.
rows.note: Written for Moonshot Grant. Shown on Moonshot Grant and Citation Engine. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 7. Security: A security team in coral-trimmed tactical gear sweeping through the glass doors of a sleek corporate headquarters lobby in daylight, startled suited figures with raised hands, papers drifting off a reception desk.
rows.note: Written for Headquarters Raid. Shown on Headquarters Raid and Agency Directorate. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 8. Power: A bright analysts' desk overlooking a city, three people at a long curved desk studying large painted charts of the city's power use with a model of the grid's pylons and substations laid out on the table in front of them.
rows.note: Written for Grid Analytics Desk. Shown on Aegis Grid Lockdown and Grid Analytics Desk. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.

rows.label: 9. Security: A road winding over green hills with a small checkpoint on each rise, each a booth and a striped barrier with two guards checking a car, the chain of checkpoints running away to the horizon.
rows.note: Written for Checkpoint Network. Shown on Bounty Board and Checkpoint Network. Tile on: keep. Tile off: reject.
